subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘JUDGE’ is written as ‘47’, and ‘CROSS’ is written as ‘74’. How will ‘BRIEF’ be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] The logic followed here is: **The sum of the positional value of the given word.**​ ‘JUDGE’ is written as ‘47’ ​
